---
title: Joining threads
---
When one thread wants to wait for another thread to complete, it invokes `pthread_join`. Here is my wrapper for `pthread_join`:

``` {title=""}
void join_thread (pthread_t thread)
{
  int ret = pthread_join (thread, NULL);
  if (ret == -1) {
    perror ("pthread_join failed");
    exit (-1);
  }
}
```

The parameter is the handle of the thread you want to wait for. All my function does is call `pthread_join` and check the result.
